answer_1.quote: In this paper, we investigate the ability of several current LLMs to generate age-appropriately simplified stories for children, as well as an examination of how modern lexical simplification models generalize to the domain of children's stories to enhance their educational potential.

answer_2.quote: we use the following metrics. Average Age of Acquisition... Highest Age of Acquisition... Readability Scores: Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Level, Gunning-Fog Index, and Automated Readability Index.
